E-commerce engineering project

Store Hub

The problem

An e-commerce application needs to connect product discovery, customer support and administrative information across different user roles.

My contribution

I developed a multi-role PHP and PostgreSQL platform with AI-driven personalisation, intelligent product search, a session-aware support chatbot and business intelligence reporting.

Technologies and approach

PHP application logic and a PostgreSQL relational database, with separate platform responsibilities supported through multiple user roles.

What it delivers

The project brings storefront and management capabilities together in one application. Source code is available for reviewing the implementation.

Current status

The repository is the reviewable project output; this portfolio does not present it as a verified production deployment.
